Marketing & Sales Manager

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

jobs.title: Sales Project Manager, Logistic Systems
jobs.description:
Company Description

BEUMER Group is an international manufacturing leader in intralogistics in the fields of conveying, loading, palletising, packaging, sortation and distribution technology. BEUMER Group offers the right solution for almost every logistic challenge. We are a family owned, intralogistics leader, where tradition and innovation go hand in hand. We are proud of what our employees create each day. Integrity, Inspiration, Quality and Teamwork!

Job Description

The Sales Project Manager, Logistic Systems plays a crucial and multifaceted role, requiring a deep understanding of BEUMER products and applications. As a senior position, the Sales Project Manager serves as the primary liaison between the customer and BEUMER teams, ensuring the seamless coordination of techno-commercial activities. They collaborate closely with Sales, Systems Engineering, Operations, and Software/Controls departments to align system designs, produce comprehensive technical documents, and develop estimates and proposals—all while actively engaging with clients. After the sale, the Sales Project Manager facilitates a smooth technical and commercial handover from the sales team to operations.

Key Responsibilities

Subject Matter Expertise:

Become an expert in BEUMER products and applications.
Stay up to date on industry trends and developments.

Proposal Development

Understand customer requirements and business objectives and recommend appropriate products and solutions to meet their needs.
Analyze customer requirements to identify system design needs.
Support Systems Engineering Team to design end-to-end logistics solutions, including conveyor systems, sortation systems solutions using 2D and 3D CAD.
Analyze logistics workflows and processes to identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks, proposing optimizations and automation opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce costs.
Support the team to calculate throughput, performance, functionalities etc. of the proposed solutions and compare them against customer goals/objectives.
Customize and configure products to meet customer-specific requirements, including developing prototypes, conducting feasibility studies, and performing testing and validation.

Collaboration

Lead pre-sales collaboration efforts with Sales, Systems Engineering, Operations and Software/Controls departments to design and develop robust system solutions.
Serve as the primary senior technical & commercial point of contact for customers, offering expert pre-sales and post-sales support.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including software developers, project managers, and operations staff, to ensure successful proposal development.
Lead the hand-over process from sales to operations ensuring smooth coordination between all parties involved while maintaining the customer relationship. correct design parameters for the proposed solution.

Sales Support

Create technical and commercial presentations for the sales team.
Ensure sales team is well supported with the technical and commercial topics.
Act as customer's representative ensuring smooth coordination and achievement of customer goals.
Stay informed about industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies in logistic systems and supply chain management.
Attend and support the sales team with client meetings and calls as required, providing expert technical guidance.

Compensation Range
: $115,000.00 - $125,000.00 annually

The posted salary range reflects the compensation the company reasonably expects to offer for this position. Actual compensation will not be less than the posted minimum and will be based on multiple factors.

Qualifications

Key Requirements and Professional Attributes:

Bachelor's degree in Industrial, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering (Master's degree preferred) with project management skills
5+ years of experience in technical sales or systems engineering, with a focus on warehouse automation
Proven experience in leading technical projects and teams.
Strong time management and attention to detail.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
High computer literacy in MS Office Suite.
Familiarity with 2D and 3D modeling like AutoCAD and SolidEdge.
Exceptional mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Strong active listening skills for customer satisfaction and technical insight.
Preferred experience with automated systems and MS Excel/VBA programming.
Demonstrated ability to set and meet goals, work collaboratively, and care for team members.

Additional Information

BEUMER is an innovative company, where every employee is part of the "family". Because our employees are our most important asset, here are some of benefits we currently offer full-time employees:

Medical & Dental Premiums: We cover 100% of the premiums for you and your eligible dependents.
401(k) with Generous Match: Secure your financial future with our competitive retirement plan.
Life Insurance / Long Term Disability: Peace of mind for you and your loved ones. Yes, we cover that too!
Ancillary Insurances: Including vision, accident, and critical illness insurance.
Generous Paid Time Off: Achieve the optimal work-life balance.
Company Holidays: Enjoy paid time off on designated company holidays including additional flex days for times that matter most!
Performance-Based Bonus: Eligibility to participate in our Target Agreement Plan for bonus potential.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Talent Acquisition Innovation
jobs.description:
Included Health is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Talent Acquisition Innovation, to build and run the operating system for our highest-volume hiring areas, initially Clinical, Behavioral Health and Member Care.

This role will create consistent operating cadence across high-volume pods, improve funnel performance, manage agency and vendor effectiveness, and expand the use of automation and AI-enabled workflows. The PM will translate hiring goals into capacity plans, identify risks early, and drive corrective action across the recruiting machine.

This is not a traditional recruiting coordinator or status-reporting role. The successful candidate will operate as a program owner: diagnosing problems, recommending solutions, and holding cross-functional partners accountable for measurable outcomes.

Responsibilities

High-Volume Operating Model

Build and maintain a standardized operating model across high-volume recruiting pods.
Establish operating cadences, planning processes, scorecards, and escalation paths.
Translate hiring goals into funnel requirements, capacity plans, and execution priorities.
Maintain a consolidated view of hiring health, risks, dependencies, and corrective actions.
Partner with pod owners to improve pacing, stakeholder readiness, funnel quality, and delivery against goals.
Identify opportunities to standardize and scale the high-volume model across additional hiring areas.

Agency and Vendor Management

Own day-to-day operating performance for high-volume agency and vendor partners.
Establish clear expectations and scorecards covering submissions, quality, fill rate, time-to-fill, pricing, responsiveness, and corrective action.
Create a consistent process for agency onboarding, performance reviews, escalation, and offboarding.
Shift routine agency management and reporting away from senior leaders and toward exception-based escalation.
Recommend when work should be handled internally, through contractors, agencies, or automation based on demand, economics, speed, role complexity, and available capacity.

Automation and AI-Enabled Recruiting

Expand BrightHire, AI interviewer, and related workflow adoption across high-volume recruiting.
Partner with Talent Operations on workflow design, tooling, and automation opportunities.
Automate reporting, funnel tracking, quality monitoring, and partner performance visibility.
Identify friction points and run targeted process-improvement pilots.
Measure the impact of automation through recruiter hours saved, funnel conversion, time-to-fill, quality, and candidate experience.

Reporting and Decision Support

Own the consolidated weekly high-volume hiring health report.
Report on open requisitions, aging, progress to goal, funnel health, capacity, internal versus agency mix, and at-risk work.
Clearly communicate what changed, what is at risk, what action is being taken, and what decision or support is needed.
Use data to distinguish capacity gaps from execution, process, quality, prioritization, or stakeholder issues.
Build clear recommendations for resourcing, agency allocation, and process changes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner closely with leaders on Clinical/BH capacity, performance, staffing, and resourcing decisions.
Partner with pod owners on cohort health, stakeholder readiness, funnel decisions, and corrective action.
Work with Talent Operations to align high-volume workflows with broader TA systems and infrastructure.
Serve as a central escalation point for cross-pod operating issues.
Influence without direct authority and create accountability across recruiters, pod owners, agencies, Talent Partners, and hiring leaders.

Required Qualifications

7+ years of experience in recruiting operations, program management, high-volume recruiting, staffing, or a related field.
Experience owning complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.
Experience using AI-enabled recruiting workflows.
Strong understanding of recruiting funnels, capacity planning, conversion metrics, and hiring economics.
Demonstrated ability to use data to diagnose problems and drive operational decisions.
Experience improving processes through automation, technology, or workflow redesign.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with senior leaders.
Ability to influence and create accountability across teams without direct authority.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-changing environment.
Sound judgment, urgency, and comfort surfacing risk early.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Clinical, Behavioral Health, Member Care, Urgent Care, or other high-volume hiring environments.
Experience with recruiting systems such as Lever, BrightHire, or similar tools.
Experience building agency scorecards, operating dashboards, or capacity models.
Experience partnering with senior Talent Acquisition or business leaders on workforce planning.

Success In This Role Looks Like

High-volume pods operate against a consistent cadence, shared metrics, and clear ownership model.
Agency and vendor performance is visible, managed against defined expectations, and escalated appropriately.
Hiring risks are surfaced early with clear recommendations and corrective actions.
Recruiter and pod-owner time shifts away from manual reporting and routine coordination toward higher-value recruiting work.
Automation and AI workflows produce measurable improvements in efficiency, funnel health, and candidate experience.
TA leaders have a reliable, consolidated view of high-volume hiring performance.
The High Volume operating model becomes repeatable across additional hiring areas.

Physical/Cognitive Requirements

Prompt and regular attendance at assigned work location.
Ability to remain seated in a stationary position for prolonged periods.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively using computers and other office-related equipment.

The base salary range for this full-time position is $127,660 – $168,000 per year
in the United States. This posted range reflects the portion of our internal salary band that is currently funded for new hires in this role across our standard labor markets ( Zones A–C
).

For context, these markets include Zone A
(e.g., Phoenix AZ, San Antonio TX, Columbus OH, Charlotte NC), Zone B
(e.g., Chicago IL, Denver CO, San Diego CA, Houston TX), and Zone C
(e.g., Los Angeles CA, Seattle WA, Washington, D.C., Boston MA). At this time, we are not budgeting for hires in higher-cost Zone D markets
(e.g., San Francisco Bay Area CA, New York City NY, San Jose CA) for this role. Within this range, individual pay is determined by work location, skills, experience, and internal equity. We use structured salary bands and geographic zones based on cost of labor to keep pay fair and consistent.

Benefits & Perks

In addition to receiving a great compensation package, the compensation package may include, depending on the role, the following and more:

Remote-first culture
401(k) savings plan through Fidelity
Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage through multiple medical plan options (including disability insurance)
Paid Time Off ("PTO") and Discretionary Time Off (“DTO")
12 weeks of 100% Paid Parental leave
Family Building & Compassionate Leave: Fertility coverage, $25,000 for surrogacy/adoption, and paid leave for failed treatments, adoption or pregnancies.
Work-From-Home reimbursement to support team collaboration home office work

Your recruiter will share more about the salary range and benefits package for your role during the hiring process.

About Included Health

Included Health is a new kind of healthcare company, delivering integrated virtual care and navigation. We’re on a mission to raise the standard of healthcare for everyone. We break down barriers to provide high-quality care for every person in every community — no matter where they are in their health journey or what type of care they need, from acute to chronic, behavioral to physical. We offer our members care guidance, advocacy, and access to personalized virtual and in-person care for everyday and urgent care, primary care, behavioral health, and specialty care. It’s all included. Learn more at includedhealth.com.

Included Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Included Health considers all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, and California law.

Included Health uses AI-assisted tools at select stages of the hiring process to enhance efficiency, consistency, and communication. AI does not make hiring decisions—final decisions are made exclusively by our recruiting and hiring teams.

jobs.title: IT Security Project Manager
jobs.description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?

Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.

The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.

Pay And Benefits

Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
Comprehensive health and life insurance and well-being benefits, based on location
Pension / Retirement benefits
Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.
DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).

The Impact You Will Have In This Role

Being a member of IT Cybersecurity & Platform Engineering tema, the Secure Platforms team is seeking a highly motivated and technically proficient Associate to help drive strategic initiatives across DTCC's enterprise cryptographic and trust services portfolio. This role sits at the intersection of engineering execution, technical program leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.

You will partner closely with engineering leaders and service owners responsible for Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC), PKI and Machine Identity, Secrets Management, Encryption Services, and Cryptographic Platforms. You will help ensure these services are prepared for and aligned with major enterprise initiatives, including cyber resiliency programs, infrastructure modernization, platform transformations, and regulatory-driven technology changes.

Success in this role requires both technical depth and strong organizational leadership. You will be expected to understand complex technical concepts, engage engineering teams on architectural and implementation decisions, coordinate work across multiple stakeholders, track execution against milestones, identify risks and dependencies, and drive initiatives to successful outcomes.

Your Primary Responsibilities

Lead and coordinate cross-service initiatives impacting Secure Platforms technologies.
Drive execution of strategic programs spanning Post-Quantum Cryptography, PKI, Secrets Management, Machine Identity, and Cryptographic Services.
Partner with engineering teams to assess impacts, define requirements, track deliverables, and resolve blockers.
Serve as a technical liaison between Secure Platforms and enterprise technology teams.
Build and maintain program plans, dependency maps, risk registers, executive status updates, and readiness assessments.
Support enterprise initiatives such as cyber resiliency programs, recovery environments, infrastructure modernization efforts, segmentation programs, cloud transformations, and other strategic initiatives.
Analyze technical architectures and identify impacts to cryptographic services and trust infrastructure.
Facilitate working sessions, technical reviews, and stakeholder governance forums.
Develop metrics, reporting, and dashboards to measure execution progress and organizational readiness.
Contribute to technical strategy discussions and help translate strategic objectives into actionable engineering outcomes.
Assist service owners with roadmap planning, adoption tracking, and enterprise engagement activities.

**NOTE: The Primary Responsibilities of this role are not limited to the details above. **

Qualifications

Minimum of 4 years of experience in cybersecurity, platform engineering, infrastructure engineering, identity and access management, cryptography, or technical program leadership.
Bachelor's degree preferred and/or equivalent experience.
Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional technical initiatives.
Understanding of one or more of the following domains: - Public Key Infrastructure (PKI)
Secrets Management
Machine Identity
Cryptography and Key Management
Cloud Security
Identity and Access Management
Post-Quantum Cryptography
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, architects, senior leadership, and business stakeholders.
Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Experience tracking multiple workstreams and managing complex dependencies.

Talents Needed For Success

Technical curiosity and willingness to learn emerging security and cryptographic technologies.
Ability to influence without direct authority and drive outcomes across organizational boundaries.
Strong program management and execution skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and helping teams navigate complex problems.
Ability to balance strategic thinking with execution-oriented delivery.
Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
Collaborative mindset with a passion for building relationships across engineering organizations.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Company Description

Digitas Health is the modern creative agency that takes on the biggest moments in healthcare
, raises the standard of creative, and connects people, partners, and ideas to create work that earns its place in culture. Purpose-built for today’s complex and evolving landscape, we partner with some of the world’s largest healthcare brands to do big things by moving faster, connecting deeper, and unlocking new possibilities at the intersection of creativity, data, technology, and empathy. Guided by our purpose, Connected for Good, and fueled by a vibrant, magnetic culture
—we deliver meaningful work that drives relevance, changes behavior, and creates lasting impact, always grounded in humanity, not just technology. As part of Publicis Health and Publicis Groupe
, we bring together entrepreneurial energy with the scale, stability, and depth of one of the world’s leading communications networks.

At Digitas Health, what sets us apart isn’t just who we work with, it’s how we work and how it feels to be here. Our culture attracts curious, driven people who want to make a difference and be part of something bigger.
Our teams are intentionally crafted across disciplines, perspectives, and experience levels, bringing strategy, creativity, data, and technology together from the start. We believe the best ideas come from curiosity, collaboration, and healthy debate and we expect people here to be thoughtful, engaged, and eager to shape what’s next. If you’re energized by complexity, motivated by impact, and excited to help redefine how healthcare connects with people, we’d love to meet you!

Overview

Project Managers independently lead projects across multiple workstreams, owning delivery from planning through completion while balancing scope, timing, budget, quality, and client expectations.

Project Managers bring clarity to complexity. They identify risks early, make informed decisions, manage competing priorities, and adjust plans before issues affect scope, cost, quality, or client confidence. They are trusted to own outcomes, navigate day-to-day trade-offs, and create confidence for teams, stakeholders, and clients through sound judgment and reliable execution.

As active delivery leaders, Project Managers apply strong project management, financial, and operational expertise to keep work moving forward, improve how work gets done, and strengthen delivery outcomes. They use new tools, technologies, and ways of working to improve visibility, efficiency, and delivery outcomes as client and business needs evolve.

Responsibilities

Strategy

Develop and manage project plans that establish a clear path to successful delivery across multiple workstreams.
Make day-to-day decisions that balance scope, timing, budget, quality, resource availability, and client needs.
Anticipate risks, trade-offs, and resource constraints early, adjusting plans and priorities to protect project outcomes.
Manage project scope and financial health proactively, identifying risks, evaluating options, and recommending solutions that support successful delivery and responsible business outcomes.
Lead discussions around priorities, resource needs, and delivery approaches, helping teams stay focused on the work that matters most.
Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools, and ways of working, applying changes that strengthen delivery outcomes and team effectiveness.

Delivery

Own successful delivery across multiple workstreams, ensuring work is completed on time, on budget, and at the expected level of quality.
Actively manage project scope, budgets, forecasts, timelines, and resource plans, identifying risks and opportunities early and driving solutions that support successful delivery and responsible business outcomes.
Monitor project health and delivery performance, proactively mitigating risks, addressing issues, and communicating impacts before they affect outcomes.
Manage scope changes, evolving priorities, and project constraints, helping teams understand implications, evaluate options, and move forward with clarity.
Lead cross-functional teams through delivery challenges, resolving dependencies, removing obstacles, and driving action to keep work moving forward.
Apply and evolve processes, tools, technologies, and AI-enabled ways of working that improve visibility, efficiency, execution quality, and delivery outcomes.

Knowledge

Apply project management, financial, and operational expertise to support sound delivery decisions and successful project outcomes.
Develop accurate estimates, scopes of work, budgets, forecasts, and resource plans that support effective planning and execution.
Apply financial and contractual knowledge to evaluate project health, identify risks early, and make recommendations that support responsible business outcomes.
Use project management platforms, workflow tools, and reporting to identify trends, inform decisions, and improve delivery performance.
Understand the business objectives behind the work and apply that context to delivery decisions, prioritization, and stakeholder discussions.
Evaluate and apply new tools, technologies, and AI-enabled ways of working that improve efficiency, visibility, and delivery outcomes.

Leadership

Build trust and confidence with teams, stakeholders, and clients through sound judgment, accountability, and follow-through.
Communicate project status, risks, decisions, and trade-offs clearly, distilling complex information into the key points teams and clients need to understand, so teams and clients understand what is happening, why it matters, and what comes next.
Manage client and stakeholder relationships proactively, addressing concerns early and maintaining confidence in delivery.
Own project outcomes by following issues through resolution and making the day-to-day decisions needed to keep work moving.
Bring forward practical recommendations, solutions, and next steps when teams need clarity or direction.
Use evolving tools, technologies, and ways of working to improve communication, collaboration, and delivery confidence.

Qualifications

What You Bring

3-5 years of agency, marketing, communications, healthcare, or related experience leading project delivery across multiple workstreams and stakeholders.
Strong project management and financial management skills, with the ability to balance scope, timing, budget, quality, and client needs.
Sound judgment and the confidence to make day-to-day decisions that keep work moving forward.
Strong communication and relationship management skills, with the ability to build alignment, navigate challenges, and create confidence with teams and clients.
A proactive approach to problem-solving, with the ability to identify risks, evaluate options, and recommend a path forward.
Curiosity about new tools, technologies, and ways of working, with the ability to apply them to improve delivery outcomes.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Additional Information

Our Publicis Groupe motto “Viva La Différence” means we’re better together, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. It means we honor and celebrate all identities, across all facets of intersectionality, and it underpins all that we do as an organization. We are focused on fostering belonging and creating equitable & inclusive experiences for all talent.

Publicis Groupe provides robust and inclusive benefit programs and policies to support the evolving and diverse needs of our talent and enable every person to grow and thrive. Our benefits package includes medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401K, as well as parental and family care leave, family forming assistance, tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off.

If you require accommodation or assistance with the application or onboarding process specifically, please contact USMTTACompliance@publicis.com.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Compensation Range: USD $60,800.00 - USD $84,000.00/Annually. This is the pay range the Company believes it will pay for this position at the time of this posting. Consistent with applicable law, compensation will be determined based on the skills, qualifications, and experience of the applicant along with the requirements of the position, and the Company reserves the right to modify this pay range at any time. Temporary roles may be eligible to participate in our freelancer/temporary employee medical plan through a third-party benefits administration system once certain criteria have been met. For regular roles, the Company will offer medical coverage, dental, vision, disability, 401k, and paid time off. BAE Systems is seeking a Senior Technical Project Manager to support our work for the U.S. Navy's Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) command. This position collaborates with a Program Engineer to lead one of several complex projects within a dynamic, large system-of-systems engineering portfolio, and requires a detail-oriented self-starter who can work effectively with individuals at all levels. Excellent leadership, organization, and communication skills are critical; the strongest candidates will have some systems engineering experience in addition to expert project/program management skills.

Responsibilities Include

Define and manage a master project plan, establish a governance framework, and maintain a weekly work management cadence to ensure timely completion of deliverables and achievement of milestones.
Collaborate with multiple stakeholders to manage all phases of the systems engineering lifecycle—requirements, analysis, design, implementation, testing, and deployment—while ensuring alignment to stakeholder needs.

Help develop industry-specific delivery accelerators (e.g., templates, best practices, automation tools).
Manage and monitor risks and issues, and develop mitigation plans.
Maintain project collaboration and artifact repository sites.

About BAE Systems and the U.S. Navy’s (USN’s) Portfolio Acquisition Executive (PAE) Strategic Systems Programs (SSP)

Our organization has supported the USN’s PAE SSP continually since the command’s inception in the 1950s. PAE SSP developed the first sea-based, underwater-launched Strategic Weapons System (SWS), a defense system that is critical to our national security. PAE SSP has maintained and upgraded the sea-based SWS for more than six decades, and we have been there every step of the way: it is the ultimate stealthy weapons system, and is one leg of the U.S. nuclear triad. Containing over 70% of our nation’s nuclear arsenal, its importance to maintaining world peace cannot be overstated. Development of the Columbia-class submarine—the most advanced nuclear-powered, nuclear-armed submarine ever designed—and the D5LE2 system are underway, and rollout will begin within the next decade. The USN projects this system to be operational through 2084, meaning the program will have a total life span of more than 120 years. This is a truly unique program, and the BAE Systems employees who support it understand that they’re part of an important legacy.

As a decades-long sole-source partner on multiple contracts on behalf of our customer, our program has remarkable stability and is concurrently experiencing significant growth. These factors combine to provide ample opportunity for professional growth and development for capable and talented individuals on our team.

BAE Systems, Inc. is a wholly owned U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, which provides some of the world's most advanced, technology-led defense, aerospace, and security solutions. As one of the top ten defense contractors, we employ a skilled workforce of around 100,000 people in more than 40 countries. We develop, engineer, manufacture, and support products and systems to protect national security and keep people safe.

Bachelor's degree or higher
8+ years of experience managing complex DoD/DoW projects or programs
PMP certification
At least 1 year of experience in or supporting the U.S. Navy
Experience using MS SharePoint as a project repository
Understanding of basic systems engineering concepts and processes

Experience with or supporting U.S. Navy submarine shipboard and/or weapon systems

About The Department Of Employment And Workplace Relations

We are committed to empowering futures, ensuring rights and enriching lives. We support people to have safe, secure and well-paid work with the skills for a sustainable future as we ourselves strive to be a model employer.

We provide the framework for fair and productive relationships between employers and employees. We also oversee skills development and training initiatives to support those entering the workforce or re-training to take advantage of emerging employment opportunities.

With us, your work directly contributes to shaping the employment landscape. Whether you are engaging in policy development, program implementation, or direct support services, your efforts will have a tangible impact on job seekers, employees and the economy by giving them a framework to build a future anchored and realised through employment.

It is our ambition to do things differently, to create the ‘department of great jobs’– where our people reflect our purpose.

The Role

Reporting to the Director, Business Management Team, the Technical Project Manager is responsible for leading the delivery of complex technology projects and initiatives across the Enterprise Technology Division (ETD).

The role provides end-to-end project leadership for New Policy Proposal (NPP) and capital funded initiatives and acts as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders and ETD delivery teams.

The role requires a strong blend of project management expertise and technical understanding to effectively coordinate activities across multiple technical disciplines and identify delivery impacts arising from changes to project scope, priorities or schedules.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Travel Program Manager oversees the day-to-day operation of the firm's travel program and serves as the primary liaison between internal stakeholders and the firm's Travel Management Company (TMC), preferred travel suppliers, and other external travel partners. Working under the direction of the Senior Manager, this role ensures the TMC and supplier network deliver against firm expectations, resolves escalated traveler issues, and supports continuous improvement of the program through data analysis, policy administration, and stakeholder engagement.

Rather than performing day-to-day booking or administrative tasks, the Travel Program Manager directs the TMC and supplier network to execute against firm expectations. Success is measured by the strength of vendor and internal relationships, traveler satisfaction and compliance, and the operational effectiveness of the program. A hybrid work arrangement is available for this position.

A career at Nixon Peabody is the opportunity to do work that matters. It’s the chance to use your knowledge to shape what’s ahead. To share, to innovate, to learn at a firm that taps the power of collective thinking.

We’ve created a dynamic, energizing environment that promotes success for our clients and each other. We offer fast growth, connectedness and training in business as well as law. And our rigorous standards assure you are part of a diverse team of top talent at every turn.

If you’re someone who’s looking toward the future, we’d love to hear from you.

Location:
Rochester, NY; Albany, NY; Boston, MA; Providence, RI; New York City, NY; Long Island, NY; Washington, DC

Reporting Relationships:
This position will report to the Senior Manager, Procurement and Travel

Essential Job Responsibilities:

Vendor Relationship & Program Oversight

Serve as the firm's day-to-day relationship contact for the TMC and key travel suppliers (airlines, hotels, ground transportation, and related providers), holding partners accountable to service levels and firm expectations.
Participate in and help lead recurring business reviews with the TMC and preferred suppliers; support the Senior Manager in translating outcomes into program improvements.
Act as the escalation point for travel-related issues raised by attorneys, business professionals, and travel arrangers; drive issues to resolution through the TMC and supplier network.
Represent the firm at industry briefings, supplier events, and travel program meetings as appropriate

Program Performance & Continuous Improvement

Monitor travel program performance, policy compliance, traveler experience, and supplier performance; identify trends and coordinate corrective action through the TMC.
Analyze firm travel data and industry trends to identify cost-savings opportunities, policy refinements, and program enhancements; present findings and recommendations to the Senior Manager.
Oversee the day-to-day configuration and optimization of the firm's online booking tool, directing the TMC on maintenance, enhancements, and user-experience improvements.
Partner with Finance to ensure travel transaction data flows correctly for client billing and firm reporting; serve as the point of contact for data-integrity and reconciliation issues.

Policy, Communications & Traveler Enablement

Administer the firm's travel policy: monitor compliance, recommend updates to the Senior Manager, and interpret policy for stakeholders.
Develop communications, guidance, and training resources for firm travelers and travel arrangers; coordinate with the TMC to deliver booking-tool training and onboarding.
Serve as a subject-matter resource on travel program questions, including duty of care and traveler safety in coordination with the TMC.

Group & Event Travel Oversight

Provide oversight and coordination for group travel and firm events, directing the TMC and suppliers to execute logistics and ensuring firm requirements are met.
Support the establishment and management of agreements for lodging, ground transportation, and related services in support of firm events and meetings.

Supplier Agreements & Negotiation

Support negotiations with travel suppliers to secure favorable pricing, terms, and service commitments; partner with the Senior Manager, Procurement, and Legal on contract execution.
Provide input on the firm's preferred supplier program, recommending additions, changes, or consolidations based on spend, traveler needs, and market conditions.

Program Documentation

Document program standards, procedures, and vendor playbooks to support continuity, succession, and consistent execution.

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential job responsibility listed above, satisfactorily, with or without reasonable accommodation. Nixon Peabody retains the right to change or assign other duties to this position. The requirements listed below are representative of the skills and abilities required.

Bachelor's degree in Business, Hospitality, Finance, or a related field preferred. Relevant work experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
4+ years of corporate travel program or related experience, ideally in a professional services or similarly complex environment.
Experience working closely with a Travel Management Company and preferred supplier programs.
Experience supporting supplier negotiations and administering corporate travel policy.
Experience analyzing travel spend and program data.
Global Business Travel Association (GBTA) certification or similar (e.g., GTP, GLP) a plus.
Strong relationship-management and stakeholder-communication skills, with the ability to hold vendors accountable and navigate internal partnerships across all levels of the firm.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to translate data into recommendations.
Sound judgment and the ability to distinguish between issues to resolve directly, escalate, or delegate to the TMC/supplier.
Working knowledge of the corporate travel ecosystem, including TMC operations, online booking tools, and supplier dynamics.
Proactive, solutions-oriented approach with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced professional services environment.

We’re growing our Environmental Project Management team and excited to welcome several Project Managers into our Project, Programme Management and PMO community.

In this role, you’ll play an important part in delivering multi-disciplinary environmental projects, working closely with Senior Project Managers and Technical Leads to keep projects safe, on track and within budget. You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership of smaller projects, while also supporting on larger programmes and portfolios, giving you the breadth and experience to grow your career.

Beyond project delivery, there’s scope to mentor junior colleagues, contribute to team development, and shape the future of our Environmental Project Management capability.

Support the development of project proposals, helping to define requirements, scope, resourcing, programme and budget for successful delivery.

Proactively manage change and risk, working closely with technical teams to ensure projects stay aligned with scope, contractual requirements and governance standards.

An interest in the environment and/or sustainable land development, alongside a positive, proactive approach and a genuine desire to grow your career.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?

With us, you can.
Apply today

Description

At Vasion, our mission is to make digital transformation attainable for everyone. We build cloud-native enterprise software that empowers organizations to automate workflows, eliminate paper, and operate smarter. We are scaling fast, we do not do conventional, and we hire people who think the same way.

About The Role

Vasion is adopting a Product Development Life Cycle, a cross-company operating model designed to bring just enough structure to how we build and ship software. As a Program Manager on the PDLC team, you will be one of the people who makes it real.

This is not a coordination role. You will not be tracking status and scheduling syncs. You will be embedded across engineering and product management teams as a practitioner, coach, and change agent helping teams not just follow the PDLC, but understand it, trust it, and work inside it naturally.

You will split your time between two things: operating the PDLC across active programs day-to-day, and helping build and improve the framework itself. Your perspective from inside the teams will actively shape how the system evolves. Vasion's engineering organization is also moving toward agent-native development, which means genuine curiosity about AI is part of the job.

What You Will Do

PDLC Adoption and Change Enablement

Operate as an embedded PDLC practitioner, modeling the framework and helping cross-functional partners understand why it exists and how to use it
Coach engineering and product management team members on PDLC practices by meeting them where they are, not where the playbook says they should be
Build trust through consistency, follow-through, and genuine partnership, not process authority
Communicate the value of the PDLC to engineering clearly and often: reduced context-switching, clearer scope handoffs, fewer rebuilds, better predictability

PDLC Framework Contribution and Development

Partner with the VP of PgM to build, document, and refine processes, templates, stage gate criteria, and governance standards
Develop and maintain playbooks and documentation that make the PDLC accessible across Product Management and Engineering
Translate on-the-ground experience into framework improvements

End-to-End Program Management

Own the full lifecycle of assigned programs from Discovery through Grow: scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and deliverables at every stage
Build program plans that give Product Management, Engineering, Design, QA, and Go-to-Market a shared view of what is happening, what is next, and who owns what
Stay ahead of risks and blockers; bring well-reasoned options to the VP before problems compound
Facilitate kick-offs, stage gate reviews, cross-functional syncs, and retrospectives to drive clear outcomes and documented next steps every time

Cross-Functional Alignment and Communication

Serve as the day-to-day coordination point between Product Management, Engineering, Design, QA, and Go-to-Market for programs in your portfolio
Surface and resolve cross-team misalignments and dependency conflicts before they impact delivery

Reporting and Documentation

Maintain accurate, up-to-date program documentation throughout the full lifecycle
Treat documentation as a core part of program quality in order to make programs reproducible, learnable, and increasingly agent-ready

5-8 years of program management experience in software, at the program level across multiple teams
Cross-functional programs through multiple phases of a product or software development lifecycle
Embedded directly within engineering and/or product management teams, not a centralized PMO
Participated in or drove a process or operating model change
Fluency with Atlassian (J

ira/Confluence), Notion, and/or Adobe Workfront

We are seeking a highly skilled and results-oriented Senior Technical Business Analyst
to drive technology delivery, systems analysis, and business transformation initiatives across the Acquisitions, Marketing, and Risk portfolios
supporting the U.S. Consumer Credit Cards business.

This role plays a critical part in enabling business growth, risk management, regulatory compliance, customer acquisition, and digital transformation initiatives through the delivery of scalable, secure, and innovative technology solutions. As demand and portfolio complexity continue to increase, this position serves as a key technology and business partner responsible for bridging strategic business objectives with technical execution.

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor and liaison across Product, Business, Technology, Architecture, Operations, Data, Risk, and Vendor teams to ensure business needs are translated into well-defined solutions that drive measurable business value. This individual will leverage deep expertise in application development, systems analysis, business analysis, data integration, and technology delivery to guide initiatives from concept through implementation and post-production adoption.

This role requires a unique combination of technical expertise, business acumen, analytical problem-solving, leadership, and stakeholder management skills to successfully navigate a highly complex environment with multiple priorities, dependencies, and regulatory considerations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Technology & Business Partnership

Partner closely with business leaders, product owners, technology teams, architects, and operational stakeholders to align technology investments with strategic business priorities.
Support the delivery of initiatives that improve customer acquisition, customer engagement, marketing effectiveness, credit risk management, and operational efficiency.
Translate strategic business goals into actionable technology roadmaps, requirements, and implementation plans.
Act as a trusted advisor to business and technology leadership by providing insights, recommendations, and solution alternatives that balance business value, risk, cost, and technical feasibility.
Participate in portfolio planning, investment prioritization, capacity planning, roadmap development, and strategic technology discussions.

Business Analysis & Requirements Leadership

Lead the discovery, analysis, documentation, and validation of complex business, functional, technical, data, and non-functional requirements.
Facilitate workshops, stakeholder interviews, process reviews, and solution design sessions to identify business needs and define future-state capabilities.
Develop detailed requirements artifacts, including:
Business Requirements Documents (BRDs)
Functional Requirements Documents (FRDs)
User Stories and Acceptance Criteria
Process Flows
Data Mapping Documentation
Use Cases
System Integration Specifications
Business Rules Documentation

Ensure requirements maintain clear traceability from business objectives through technical implementation and testing.

Technical Analysis & Solution Design

Perform end-to-end systems analysis across applications, databases, interfaces, APIs, workflows, and downstream integrations.
Collaborate with architecture and engineering teams to design scalable, resilient, and future-ready solutions.
Evaluate current-state systems and identify opportunities for modernization, automation, process optimization, and technical debt reduction.
Define and validate system impacts, data requirements, integration points, dependencies, and solution architecture considerations.
Provide guidance on application design decisions to ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards, security requirements, and technology strategies.
Review technical specifications and designs to ensure accurate implementation of business requirements.

Data, Integration & Digital Enablement

Analyze data flows, data lineage, business rules, and data quality requirements across multiple systems.
Partner with data and engineering teams to support API integrations, cloud-based solutions, event-driven architectures, and digital modernization initiatives.
Support enterprise data governance initiatives by ensuring accurate data definitions, controls, and end-to-end traceability.
Drive requirements and analysis activities supporting real-time decisioning, customer journey optimization, risk assessment, and marketing personalization capabilities.
Leverage data-driven insights and analytics to identify opportunities for business improvement and process efficiency.

Delivery Leadership & Execution

Lead application systems analysis efforts across multiple concurrent initiatives with varying levels of complexity and strategic importance.
Work closely with Agile delivery teams throughout all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).
Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, release planning, user acceptance testing, and production implementation activities.
Ensure requirements are implementation-ready and sufficiently detailed to support development, testing, and deployment activities.
Monitor project progress, dependencies, milestones, and deliverables to ensure successful execution.
Identify gaps, risks, roadblocks, and opportunities early and drive timely resolutions.

Risk, Controls & Regulatory Compliance

Support initiatives involving regulatory requirements, risk controls, customer privacy, and data governance standards.
Proactively identify and assess business, operational, technical, and implementation risks associated with proposed solutions.
Ensure solutions comply with corporate policies, security standards, regulatory obligations, and control frameworks.
Partner with Risk, Compliance, Audit, and Control teams to address findings, remediation activities, and control requirements.
Maintain transparency through proactive communication, issue escalation, and risk management practices.

Leadership, Collaboration & Influence

Serve as a subject matter expert across business processes, systems, and technology capabilities supporting Acquisitions, Marketing, and Risk functions.
Mentor and coach business analysts, technology analysts, and project team members to promote best practices and continuous improvement.
Drive alignment among diverse stakeholder groups with competing priorities and objectives.
Influence decision-making through data-driven analysis, business cases, and technology recommendations.
Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and delivery excellence.

Required Qualifications

6+ years of experience in Application Development, Systems Analysis, Technical Business Analysis, Product Delivery, or related technology disciplines.
Proven experience delivering complex enterprise technology solutions from requirements definition through implementation.
Strong technical foundation with the ability to understand application architectures, APIs, databases, integrations, cloud technologies, and software engineering concepts.
Extensive experience gathering, documenting, validating, and managing business, technical, process, and data requirements.
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, systems, and delivery teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, prioritize competing demands, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex business and technical issues.
Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
Experience with Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting Consumer Banking, Credit Cards, Acquisitions, Marketing, Underwriting, Credit Risk, or Customer Lifecycle Management functions.
Knowledge of customer acquisition funnels, digital marketing platforms, campaign management technologies, decision engines, and customer onboarding processes.
Experience working with cloud platforms, microservices architecture, APIs, event-driven architecture, and modern application ecosystems.
Understanding of data governance, data management, reporting, analytics, and AI-enabled business capabilities.
Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, SQL, Visio, Azure DevOps, Tableau, Power BI, or similar platforms.
Experience supporting large-scale modernization, transformation, or regulatory programs within financial services.

Success Factors

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

Strategic thinking and business acumen.
Technical depth and systems analysis expertise.
Ability to lead through influence rather than authority.
Strong ownership mentality and execution focus.
Exceptional stakeholder partnership and communication skills.
Ability to simplify highly complex business and technical concepts.
Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on innovation and efficiency.
Strong risk awareness and commitment to operational excellence.
Passion for delivering technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes and customer value.

Education

Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.
Master's degree preferred.

The Senior Power Delivery Project Manager provides technical, administrative, and commercial project management leadership for the development, execution, delivery, and monitoring of Power Delivery projects, including electric transmission, distribution, and substation initiatives, within a defined geographic region, utility client base, or technical discipline. This position will be based out of New Orleans, LA with the ability to work remotely from any mutually acceptable location in the region. You must have the ability to travel to a WSP and/or Client office for periodic face to face meetings.

As one of the world’s leading professional services firms, WSP now brings world-class expertise in power delivery and project management with the recent acquisition of POWER Engineers, Inc. Our vision is to be the preeminent pure-play global consulting firm for the world’s energy transition. And we need your help.

Your Impact

Provide Power Delivery project management leadership for large‑scale and complex utility infrastructure projects, ensuring clear task ownership, schedule accountability, and delivery milestones across transmission, distribution, and substation scopes; prepare and manage project budgets, forecasts, margins, KPIs, earned value, hours and expenses, monitor external risks and contingencies, and ensure contractual compliance and successful delivery of assigned Power Delivery project portfolios.
Develop and execute stakeholder engagement and communication strategies for utility clients, internal leadership, engineering teams, contractors, and regulators, maintaining strong relationships and providing timely reporting on project status, risks, and performance. [
Provide guidance during pursuit, initiation, and project startup phases, supporting Go/No‑Go decisions, contract and commercial reviews, pricing strategies, delivery risk assessments, and mitigation planning for Power Delivery and utility capital projects
Participate in and support the technical and commercial aspects of contract negotiations, client presentations, scope alignment discussions, and project execution meetings with IOUs, IPPs, cooperatives, and public power clients.
Actively lead and enforce appropriate technical and constructability reviews, ensuring selection of qualified engineering and discipline leads, adherence to QA/QC programs, and compliance with utility standards and WSP project quality plans.
Provide written and verbal technical input to multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery project teams and contribute strategic, risk‑informed advisory guidance to clients on schedule, cost, constructability, and execution strategy.

Manage, evaluate, and provide performance leadership to assigned staff, ensuring alignment with project objectives, safety expectations, and delivery standards

Facilitate and lead project kick‑off, safety, and execution alignment meetings with key internal and external stakeholders to establish roles, responsibilities, and delivery expectations.
Coordinate with area managers, technical leads, and resource managers to address staffing, subcontracting, and specialty support needs in a timely manner across Power Delivery programs.
Maintain regular client communications, including monthly progress reporting, safety performance, major risks/issues, and scope or budget impacts, reinforcing WSP’s role as a trusted Power Delivery advisor.
Participate in and lead problem project and recovery reviews, conducting root‑cause analysis, identifying corrective actions, and developing project recovery and mitigation plans
Ensure consistent project reporting and governance updates to clients, technical leadership, and business unit managers, proactively identifying emerging scope, schedule, cost, or risk issues.
Monitor and manage accounts receivable (AR), unbilled revenue, cash flow, and invoicing, coordinating with project accounting and finance teams to resolve issues and maintain financial health of Power Delivery projects.
Complete formal project closeout activities, including financial closeout, documentation archiving, client acceptance, and lessons‑learned workshops to support continuous improvement. [
Remain current on project management best practices, PMAP methodologies, utility delivery trends, and Power Delivery industry standards
Collaborate with cross‑disciplinary professionals to deliver integrated, future‑ready power delivery solutions, strengthening WSP’s position as a trusted advisor to utility clients.
Exercise responsible and ethical decision‑making regarding company funds, client commitments, project risks, and professional conduct, in accordance with WSP’s Code of Conduct and corporate policies.
Perform additional responsibilities as required

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Electrical, Civil, Mechanical), Engineering Technology, Physical Sciences, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience within an A/E/C, utility, EPC, or power delivery consulting environment.
12+ years of progressive post‑education experience in a project management or senior technical leadership role, preferably supporting power delivery, transmission & distribution (T&D), substation, or utility capital projects.
Highly proficient understanding of the project delivery lifecycle within the A/E/C and utility industries, including proposal development, project initiation, engineering coordination, procurement support, construction execution, commissioning, and project closeout, with a strong background in Power Delivery project management
Advanced analytical and organizational skills with demonstrated business and commercial acumen, enabling effective integration of project controls, financial performance, risk management, and client objectives.
Advanced proficiency in critical thinking, risk‑based decision‑making, and problem‑solving, including performing project management assessments, schedule and cost evaluations, forecasting, and scenario analysis to optimize Power Delivery project outcomes.
Advanced interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to engage effectively, persuasively, and professionally with executive leadership, utility clients (IOUs, IPPs, Co‑Ops, Munis), subcontractors, consultants, and internal teams.
Demonstrated self‑leadership and accountability, with strong attention to detail, quality, multitasking, and adaptability in a fast‑paced Power Delivery and utility project environment.
Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while providing technical guidance, mentoring, and leadership to mid‑level and senior project staff, with strict adherence to QA/QC, safety, and delivery standards.
Advanced proficiency in technical writing, project documentation, office automation, and project management software, including Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Visio, Project, SharePoint), scheduling tools, and Power Delivery PM platforms.
Strong experience managing the review, approval, and coordination of discipline‑specific deliverables, technical reports, scopes of work, and execution plans within a multi‑project, multi‑disciplinary Power Delivery portfolio.
Demonstrated ability to influence and gain cooperation from a broad range of stakeholders, including senior leadership, utility clients, subcontractors, consultants, and matrixed internal teams, without formal authority.
Proven commitment to workplace health, safety, and environmental performance, including adherence to WSP safety programs, drug/alcohol policies, and harassment‑free workplace standards.
Strong ability to adapt to changing project demands, including flexible schedules, outage‑driven work, and evolving client priorities common in Power Delivery and utility capital programs.
Willingness to support occasional travel to client sites, regional offices, and project locations as required to support Power Delivery project execution and client engagement.

Analyze structured and unstructured UxS movement data, geospatial sensor information, and supplementary intelligence sources to develop actionable analytical products.
Brief key decision-makers on UxS movement trends, entities, areas of interest, and evolving threat patterns through reports, presentations, and research projects.
Conduct predictive and anticipatory analysis to identify emerging UxS threats, forecast potential operational activities, and assess likely changes in adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures.
Identify patterns, anomalies, and indicators of potential future UxS activity by integrating historical movement data, geospatial information, environmental conditions, and other relevant intelligence sources.
Develop threat forecasts and risk assessments that identify potential vulnerabilities, emerging operational challenges, and areas requiring enhanced surveillance, detection, or mitigation capabilities.
Apply trend analysis, pattern-of-life assessments, and temporal and geospatial modeling to anticipate changes in UxS employment, operating environments, and threat behavior.

Predictive Analytics and Operational Decision Support

Develop and apply predictive analytical models, statistical forecasting techniques, and AI-enabled analytical tools to assess potential UxS activities, operational trends, and emerging threats.
Conduct anticipatory assessments that evaluate plausible future threat scenarios, identify early warning indicators, and provide decision-makers with actionable recommendations.
Establish and monitor indicators and warnings (I&W) to support early identification of emerging UxS threats, evolving capabilities, and changes in operational activity.
Perform scenario-based analysis and forecasting to evaluate potential threat developments, operational vulnerabilities, and C-UxS capability requirements.
Translate predictive assessments into operational recommendations that support proactive resource allocation, sensor placement, technology acquisition, and TTP development.
Evaluate the accuracy, reliability, and operational utility of predictive models through historical validation, performance metrics, and continuous analytical refinement.

Technology Assessment and Capability Development

Partner with government and industry stakeholders to define research objectives, data collection methodologies, analytical requirements, and reporting standards.
Transform analytical findings into actionable recommendations that guide C-UxS technology development, acquisition, selection, and operational employment.
Develop and manage multi-phase technology implementation roadmaps across business units, translating functional requirements into actionable system configurations.
Perform due diligence on emerging AI, machine learning, and other advanced technologies that can enhance C-UxS detection, tracking, classification, and analytical capabilities.
Identify anticipated capability gaps by evaluating projected threat evolution against existing and planned C-UxS technologies, operational concepts, and system performance.
Support technology investment and acquisition decisions by forecasting future operational requirements and assessing the effectiveness of potential C-UxS solutions against emerging threats.

Research, Modeling, and Program Support

Apply operations research, systems analysis, statistical modeling, and quantitative methodologies to complex operational and technical challenges.
Support business process improvement initiatives, including performance management, statistical process control, organizational assessment, and regulatory compliance.
Conduct modeling and simulation, strategic planning, operational analysis, and decision support to advance program objectives.
Develop analytical scenarios and simulations to assess potential UxS threat evolution, operational impacts, and the effectiveness of proposed countermeasures.
Assist with program planning and oversight, exercise development and execution, and program evaluation.
Support system-level analysis and integration activities, including assessments of emerging threats, system vulnerabilities, and operational effectiveness.
Provide technical assessment and evaluation support that complements government technical experts in applying acquisition initiatives and research, development, test, and evaluation (RDT&E) activities to DHS mission requirements.

Leadership, Collaboration, and Compliance

Communicate complex analytical findings, predictive assessments, and operational recommendations to senior government and industry leadership.
Conduct all activities in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, policies, and restrictions governing information collection, intelligence analysis, and law enforcement activities within the United States.
Supervise analytical and technical staff as assigned.
Travel domestically and internationally as required.

Minimum Qualifications

Must have an active Secret US Government clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance
Ability to pass DHS Entry on Duty (EOD) requirements and maintain Public Trust suitability
Bachelor's degree and 10 years of all-source intelligence analysis and production that includes DHS and/or DoD experience.
Experience with commercial or government GIS tools (ArcGIS or similar) and with OSINT and other data sources across the intelligence cycle
Track record of producing high-quality deliverables for senior policymakers, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings, independently or as part of a team
Strong research, analytical, interpersonal, organizational, and written and verbal communication skills, with close attention to detail and the ability to anticipate customer needs
Ability to work independently and collaboratively

Preferred Qualifications

Active Top Secret clearance and active Public Trust designation
Knowledge of C-UxS methods, industry leaders, and U.S. Government authorities
Understanding of sUAS threats and the electronic and communications systems, components, and materials relevant to DHS missions
Familiarity with DHS, DoD, or other law enforcement C-UxS efforts over the past five years
Experience with DHS GII, Aerial Armor, Hidden Level, or similar UAS detection and monitoring services

jobs.title: Market Research Analyst or Senior Analyst, Technology Practice
jobs.description:
About NRG

NRG is a leading global insights and strategy firm at the confluence of content, culture, and technology. We stay ahead of what's next, providing fresh insights to spark new ideas. We're a trusted partner to our clients, working behind the scenes to bring imagination, depth, and clarity to their biggest challenges-in entertainment, technology, lifestyle, sports, and gaming. Together, we create with confidence.

We're Proud Of Our Company's Values - These Values Guide Us As We Navigate Sunny Days, Gray Skies And Everything In Between

Do what you love. With conviction.
Where discovery lives. And impact drives.
Celebrate difference. Cultivate belonging.
Big thinking. Collectively inspired.
Embrace the journey. Be human.

The Opportunity

NRG is seeking a Research Analyst or Senior Analyst to join our Technology research practice. In this role, you'll collaborate with some of the world's most influential brands shaping the future of technology. Our team stays at the forefront of innovation-whether exploring what the next generation of technology might look like, reimagining beloved products, diving deep into the evolving role of AI, and beyond.

In this role, you will support a wide range of initiatives across the full project lifecycle from survey design to report delivery. If you're passionate about quantitative and qualitative research; if you enjoy visualizing data and discovering insights with confidence; and are looking for a great opportunity to start your career where you can make an impact, this opportunity is for you!

Your Impact

Support all phases of quantitative and qualitative research projects, including research design, questionnaire and discussion guide development, data analysis and storytelling.
Projects may include methods such as concept evaluation, brand studies, content optimization tests, messaging/positioning evaluation, creative materials tests, market sizing and segmentation.
Translate data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations through visual, creative and story-driven reports.
Help drive quality control processes at each step of the research lifecycle, from checking survey programming logic, questionnaire proofing, number checking and proofing reports and presentations for accuracy.
Partner closely with internal teams (programming, fieldwork, data processing, design) to keep projects moving forward on tight timelines.
Leverage AI-enabled approaches to enhance the speed, scale, and depth of insight generation across research and storytelling.

Who We're Looking For

Prior Experience - Prior internship or work experience in market research or consumer insights.
Writing and storytelling - You know how to connect the dots and turn complex research findings into clear, compelling narratives. Whether you are writing a report, building a presentation, or presenting to a client, you bring insights to life in a way that captures attention and drives decisions.
Curious and future-minded- You are genuinely interested in seeking information on the "whys," always digging for more information to understand what makes consumers tick. You're constantly asking "what's changing?" and "what's next?"-especially when it comes to audiences, technology, and content strategy.
Consumer-to-market translator - You're skilled at moving from consumer insight to strategic implication, helping answer the question: "So what does this mean for our technology clients?"
Problem Solver -You are a natural problem solver. When something doesn't go as planned, your first instinct is to look for a solution, rather than viewing it as a roadblock.
Data-driven critical thinker - You're comfortable working with data to identify trends and insights, including both structured (i.e. data and hard numbers) and unstructured (i.e. interviews and qualitative) data. You have experience visualizing data with tools such as Excel and PowerPoint.
Data analysis techniques and software - Familiarity with any of the following data analysis techniques would be ideal: statistical significance testing, correlation analysis, multivariate analysis techniques (such as cluster/segmentation analysis) and conjoint and discrete choice analysis. Experience with SPSS, Q, or advanced analytics is a plus but not required.
AI-curious and capable - You have experience using AI tools and are thoughtful about how AI can enhance-not replace-insight work.
Self-starter - Internally-motivated who continuously strives to get things done well, regardless of challenges encountered.You are proactive and always keep an eye on the next step.
Clear and proactive communicator - You have excellent verbal communication skills and are able to communicate clearly and succinctly. You're comfortable asking questions and sharing your point of view.
Hawk-eyed attention to detail - You notice when font sizes change unexpectedly or a proper noun isn't capitalized. Errors don't get past you and you are always focused on ensuring high levels of quality control and reporting.
Great team member - Team player who works collaboratively and harmoniously within a team and across teams. You welcome feedback because you have a zest for learning and growing.
Your degree(s) - You have a B.A./B.S. degree in areas such as Social Sciences, Psychology, Business, Marketing, Market Research, Statistics, Economics or a related field. Additional degrees are welcome!

Position Type

This is a full-time, exempt position.

What We Offer

We embrace the current era of work and what it means to be a best-in-class employer. We understand the flexibility that is required to recruit and retain incredible talent, whether it's empowering you to do your best work from the comfort of your home or supporting you if you need to take a mental health day for self-care and rest. Below is a unique blend of benefits tailored to meeting the ever-changing professional landscape.

Flexible/Remote work with optional usage of our great offices in Culver City or New York
Unlimited PTO, volunteer days and a generous number of recharge days including a full office closure during the week of Christmas and New Year's
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance Plans
401K with company match
Generous paid Parental Leave
Regular performance evaluations with opportunities for promotions and merit increases
Educational and training reimbursement plan and other training and professional development opportunities
Employee perks program (includes discounts on travel, hotels, cars, fitness, movie tickets and more)
Resources available for mental health, inclusive care and family building
NRGratitude - our company-wide employee recognition program
Regular team/company events and activities including annual summer and holiday parties
Pet friendly headquarters and pet insurance options

Our Commitment

Diversity, equity, and inclusion is at the center of all our practices to ensure that NRG is a place where people from all identities and backgrounds can thrive. NRG is committed to recruiting and retaining diverse talent by supporting their growth through learning programs, internal mobility, affinity group participation and leadership development. Our differences make us a stronger workforce and enhance our creativity and innovation. We are proud to be an inclusive workplace for all and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by state, federal, or local law.

Compensation
