We ensure that whatever the building, its design is outstanding, and its operations meet the needs of the communities it serves.

We are as committed to providing an environment where everyone can realise their unique potential. So, in joining Hoare Lea, you will experience a business that enriches your knowledge, supports your wellbeing, and welcomes your individuality. You’ll have the opportunity to participate in our 9-day fortnight scheme, thriving community groups, varied social and networking events, and extensive professional and technical development schemes. We also offer an extensive benefits package, including private medical cover, an electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme, stock options, and 25 days of annual leave (increasing with service), alongside flexible and hybrid working.

Whatever your ambitions or circumstances, our aim is to enable everyone to develop their knowledge, give their best, and enjoy what they do.

About The Role

Our multi-disciplinary software, product, and data team serves as a central hub of digital expertise and innovation, supporting projects across the company. We work collaboratively with engineers, consultants and other specialists to use data and technology to solve real-world problems and improve the services we provide to our clients.

We have an opportunity for a Data Analyst/Scientist or Senior Data Analyst/Scientist to play a key role in using data, analytics, statistical methods and data science to generate insight, support decision-making and improve our engineering services.

This is a broad analytical role. You will work across the full lifecycle of a problem: understanding stakeholder needs, exploring and assessing data, identifying appropriate analytical approaches, communicating findings and, where appropriate, developing statistical or machine-learning models or client-ready insights/tools. This is a role for someone who enjoys variety and has a critical eye for finding the right solution for the problem. Sometimes this may be exploratory analysis, a dashboard or a set of clearly defined metrics; in other cases, it may involve forecasting, statistical modelling, machine learning or building/working with AI.

It's an exciting time to join our Digital team. Working alongside a range of specialist engineers and consultants, you will be joining a collaborative, knowledgeable, highly engaged team, and offer a supportive, flexible, and high-performing work culture. In a time where building and energy resilience is ever more important, we are driving forward innovation to make an impact with data and technology.

You will have the opportunity to engage in a variety of high-impact projects, working on challenging problems for some of the UK’s most notable organisations, including the NHS and Oxford University. Our team has recently worked on creating data science-led for managing estates in hospitals, building energy forecasting models, and harnessing data on building performance to create better designed buildings of the future.

In this key and varied role, you can expect to:

Work with engineers, consultants, product teams and other stakeholders to understand their needs and translate sometimes ambiguous questions into well-defined analytical problems.
Develop and implement data-driven solutions to solve real-world business problems across the company.
Use SQL, Python and other analytical tools to investigate datasets, identify trends and relationships, test hypotheses and generate actionable insights.
Apply appropriate statistical techniques, forecasting methods, ML and AI approaches where they add value to the problem being solved.
Collaborate with the product and software engineering teams to turn analytical work into reusable tools, workflows and data-driven products where appropriate.
Develop reproducible and maintainable analytical code, following best practices, including version control, testing, and peer reviews.
Contribute to the development of analytical and data science capability across the business by sharing approaches, reusable methods and good practice

About You

To be successful in this role you’ll need:

Essential Skills

Experience applying data and analysis to real-world business, engineering or operational problems.
Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with the ability to take an initially ambiguous question and determine an appropriate analytical approach.
Ability to work on projects independently and own deliverables.
Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, analysis, visualisation and data science (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn).
Proficiency in data querying languages (e.g., SQL). Solid understanding of software engineering best practices (version control, unit testing, code review, etc.).
Strong experience with data visualisation frameworks (e.g., PowerBI, Streamlit).
Experience applying machine learning and AI, including generative AI, to real-world problems where it provides clear benefit.
Familiarity with statistical concepts and their application in data analysis.
Solid communication skills, capable of effectively engaging with and presenting findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Understanding of data governance, privacy, responsible AI and other relevant standards.

Desirable Skills

Knowledge of the engineering industry and its challenges.
Experience with one of the major machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch).
Knowledge of mathematical optimisation methods, such as linear, integer or constraint optimisation, and associated tools (e.g. OR-Tools).
Experience with MS Fabric or equivalent data warehousing solution.
Experience working in a cloud computing environment.
Familiarity with containerisation and deployment technologies (e.g., Docker, CI/CD pipelines).

For candidates joining at Senior
level, we would additionally expect you to lead more complex or ambiguous analytical projects, shape analytical approaches and overarching priorities, work independently with senior stakeholders, review and support the work of others, and help raise analytical standards across the team.

How To Apply

To apply simply complete a CV profile and submit your application.

If shortlisted, one of our recruitment team will be in touch to arrange an introductory call (about 30 minutes) to discuss the role and your experience in more detail. From there, successful candidates will be invited to attend a panel interview, either via Microsoft Teams or in person at one of our offices. We aim to provide feedback at each stage of the process.

Overview

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for turning CRM and marketing data into clear, defensible business decisions.

This role executes analysis with precision while identifying what is working, what is not, and where programs should adjust. This role sits at the center of delivery; ensuring data is accurate, analysis is sound, and outputs are ready to inform decisions.

You will support one of our client’s CRM programs across aftersales and retail touchpoints, working across data, analytics, and account teams to ensure programs are measurable, accurate, and improving over time. Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Performance Measurement and Impact Validation: Ensure programs are measured correctly and results are credible

Analyze CRM performance across channels (direct mail, email, digital)

Identify drivers of performance; audience, offer, timing, channel
Translate findings into clear “what to do next” implications

Reproduce results consistently; no one-off logic that cannot be traced

Insight Generation: Go beyond dashboards; explain what matters

Provide clear summaries of “what happened” and “why it matters”

Data Ownership and Quality: Numbers are trusted because you validate them

Validate campaign counts, audience definitions, and performance metrics
Identify and escalate data inconsistencies early
Ensure alignment between analytics outputs and campaign execution

Execution Support Across Teams: Operate within the system, not in isolation

Understand how data flows through systems and where issues can occur
Support data pulls, audience validation, and post-campaign analysis

Structured Problem Solving: Turn ambiguity into clear analysis quickly

Investigate discrepancies and performance issues with a methodical approach
Prioritize practical answers over perfect ones when timelines require it

Communication and Deliverables: Make analysis usable

Focus on clarity and accuracy; avoid overcomplicating the message

Owns the numbers end-to-end
Doesn’t pass along outputs without validating them. If something looks off, they stop and investigate

Moves quickly, but not at the expense of correctness. Knows when something is “good enough” versus when it needs deeper validation

Comfortable working through ambiguity

Communicates simply and directly

Understands how campaigns are actually deployed and checks that analytics reflects reality

Flags issues early
Raises risks, inconsistencies, or gaps before they become problems in client settings

Experience working with large datasets and complex data structures

Experience with Databricks, Python, or R for deeper analysis
Familiarity with Tableau or similar visualization tools (used for communication, not just reporting)

Senior Research Analyst, Industry Insights

About The Role

Charlotte, NC

Home Solutions is hiring a Senior Research Analyst
to build the insights that put us in front of the people who run home services.

You will research the biggest questions facing the top 50 to 100 home services companies and turn the answers into work their CEOs, CMOs, and CROs actually want to read. Each quarter you will pick a topic, go deep, and publish an industry report. Then you will use AI to turn that report into custom briefs for the 200 executives who matter most to our business.

Your work informs our CEO and Chief Revenue Officer as they build relationships with these leaders. You will report to our VP of GTM Strategy and work closely with our executive team. Within your first year, you will have published four quarterly reports and delivered custom briefs that open doors with top partners and prospects. You will also have built a repeatable AI workflow that turns one report into 200 tailored briefs in days, not months.

Your Day-to-Day

Run deep research using industry sources, third-party data, executive interviews, and our own data on 50M+ homeowners.
Design original research, including surveys and data studies, that produces insights no one else has.
Write a quarterly industry report with clear findings, sharp charts, and a real point of view.
Manage a backlog of topics each quarter with our Go-to-Market Strategy lead, based on the problems home services leaders are trying to solve right now.
Build profiles of the top 200 executives and their companies, covering their priorities, recent moves, and competitive pressures.
Use AI tools to turn each report into a custom brief for each executive and their business.
Build and refine the prompts, templates, and workflows that make personalization fast and repeatable.
Prep our CEO and Chief Revenue Officer for executive meetings, partner conversations, and industry events.
Recommend new data sources and research tools as the program grows.
Track which insights land with executives and use that feedback to sharpen the next round.

About You

2 to 4 years of experience in research or advisory at a top firm. Strategy consulting or equity research also fits.
Experience owning the full research cycle, from framing the question to presenting findings to a senior audience.
You can run a quarterly research cycle on your own while handling requests from senior leaders.
Strong written communication with the ability to turn dense research into a clear story an executive reads and digests quickly.
You are comfortable with data. You can pull, clean, and analyze datasets in Excel or similar tools, and you know when a number does not hold up.
You use AI tools every day, have built your own workflows with them, and know how to pick the right tool for the job. Coding is not required.
You are curious about how companies grow. Interest in home services, marketing, or consumer businesses is a plus.
High ownership, low ego, and a bias toward action.
Bachelor's degree required.

About Us

At Home Solutions, we're on a mission to build a more innovative future for home services. Since 2017, we've been transforming how homeowners and service providers connect-replacing outdated lead-generation models with a smarter, outcome-driven approach.

We combine proprietary media, AI, and deep data insights to reach 50M+ homeowners and match them with high-quality providers through seamless, high-intent experiences. Home Solutions has become a trusted growth engine for leading brands, helping generate over $1B in annual partner revenue while continuously innovating across channels, products, and customer experiences.

Backed by Three Ships, a growth equity firm that builds and scales digital businesses, Home Solutions is powered by a high-performance, high-ownership culture. We value people who act with urgency, challenge the status quo, and are motivated to build something enduring in one of the largest, most under-digitized categories.

Why You Should Join Us

Results: We're building a high-growth, high-performance business with strong momentum and meaningful impact across the home services ecosystem.
Opportunity: Home services is a $600 billion market that largely still operates like it's 1999. Home Solutions is shaping the industry's digital transformation and creating innovative experiences to better serve consumers and service providers.
Ownership & Impact: We operate with a high-ownership culture where individuals are expected to drive outcomes. You won't just execute-you'll help shape the business.
Exposure & Learning: You will have a front-row seat in growing a business. Your teammates have built and sold companies, managed 100s of employees, and run campaigns with Fortune 500 brands. The opportunity to build new skills and learn from smart people is endless.
Career Growth: We're building quickly, which means new opportunities emerge constantly. If you're hungry to grow, you'll have the chance to move fast and take on more.
Stability: As a privately held, debt-free company, we make disciplined, long-term financial decisions-investing in sustained growth and pursuing strategic acquisitions.
Culture: We're a team that plays to win- holding a high bar for excellence while creating an environment where people enjoy the work and the people they do it with.

The Package

Ensure technical decisions are made with consideration of programme, cost, operational impact, and whole-life performance.
Conduct regular site inspections and verify that the works are progressing in accordance with contractual and technical requirements.
Maintain project momentum and actively resolve issues rather than relying solely on consultants or contractors to drive resolution.

Stakeholder & Authority Management

Act as a key project interface between internal stakeholders, consultants, contractors, operators, and external organizations.
Coordinate requirements with port authorities, municipalities, utility providers, civil defence, customs, landlords, and other relevant government or regulatory entities.
Translate competing stakeholder requirements into practical project decisions.
Prepare clear technical papers, recommendations, presentations, and decision briefs for senior management.
Escalate issues with a clear explanation of the problem, available options, implications, and recommended course of action.

Project Controls & Governance

Maintain accurate project schedules, budgets, risk registers, change logs, action trackers, and project dashboards.
Produce concise and decision-oriented weekly and monthly project reports.
Monitor progress, critical milestones, expenditure, commitments, forecast cost, and key risks.
Maintain appropriate project documentation and ensure decisions and changes are properly recorded.
Support the continuous improvement of project-management procedures, templates, lessons learned, cost databases, and delivery standards.

Commissioning & Closeout

Coordinate testing, commissioning, inspections, snagging, statutory approvals, and operational readiness.
Manage project handover to operations and maintenance teams.
Ensure completion of as-built drawings, O&M manuals, warranties, training records, asset information, and other closeout documentation.
Track defects and outstanding obligations through final completion.
Conduct project closeout reviews and capture lessons learned for future developments.

Candidate Profile

Experience

Approximately 8–12 years of relevant professional experience
, with meaningful responsibility for project delivery.
Demonstrated experience managing infrastructure or capital projects through multiple stages of the project lifecycle.
Experience in one or more of the following is required:
Ports and container terminals
Inland container depots and dry ports
Logistics facilities and freight terminals
Warehouses and industrial developments
Marine and heavy civil infrastructure
Transport infrastructure
Exposure to brownfield or operational environments
where construction must be coordinated around ongoing operations is highly desirable.
Client-side, developer, port-operator, consultant, or strong main-contractor experience will be considered provided the candidate demonstrates genuine project ownership.

Education & Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant engineering discipline
.

Industry specific certifications are advantageous.
PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-SP, or equivalent project-management qualification is advantageous but not mandatory.
Knowledge of FIDIC or similar international forms of contract is advantageous.

Technical & Commercial Competencies

The candidate is not expected to personally design every discipline but must have enough engineering judgment to understand, interrogate, and coordinate multidisciplinary projects.
The successful candidate should be comfortable with:
Civil and infrastructure works
Pavements and container-yard development
Drainage and utilities
Buildings and warehouses
MEP and fire/life-safety systems
Port and logistics operational layouts
Marine works and dredging at a working-knowledge level
Material quantities and preliminary cost estimation
Construction methodology and constructability
Project scheduling and critical-path analysis
Tendering and technical bid evaluation
Contract administration and change management
CAPEX development and cost control
Risk identification and mitigation

Competence in tools such as Primavera P6, MS Project, Excel, AutoCAD, Power BI, BIM/Revit, or equivalent systems is advantageous.

## About the Role

We are seeking a motivated and analytical **Junior Blockchain Security Analyst** to help assess security risks in blockchain-based applications, smart contracts, and digital asset platforms.

In this role, you will support security reviews, analyze publicly available blockchain activity where relevant, document potential vulnerabilities, and assist with monitoring security alerts. You will work with experienced security engineers and developers to help improve the security and reliability of blockchain applications.

This opportunity is designed for an aspiring cybersecurity professional interested in decentralized technologies, smart contract security, and emerging digital infrastructure.

## Key Responsibilities

* Assist with reviewing blockchain applications and smart contract security findings.
* Support the identification and documentation of common smart contract vulnerabilities.
* Help review transaction patterns and investigate suspicious blockchain activity using approved tools.
* Assist with assessing wallet security practices and digital asset protection controls.
* Monitor relevant security advisories affecting blockchain platforms and decentralized applications.
* Document potential risks, testing results, and recommended remediation steps.
* Support security reviews of application integrations and blockchain interfaces.
* Help verify that reported security issues have been addressed by development teams.

* Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and common software vulnerabilities.

* Basic knowledge of programming or scripting concepts.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Ability to research technical issues and communicate findings clearly.
* Responsible handling of confidential information and sensitive security findings.
* Willingness to learn new technologies and collaborate in a remote environment.

* Awareness of common smart contract risks, including reentrancy and access control weaknesses.

* Opportunities to develop specialized blockchain security skills.
* Exposure to smart contract reviews and digital asset security practices.
* Collaboration with cybersecurity and blockchain engineering professionals.
* Professional development and potential career progression in emerging security technologies.

Prepare an updated CV highlighting your education, cybersecurity projects, programming skills, blockchain knowledge, certifications, and relevant practical experience.

Responsibilities

This role requires cross-time-zone availability (e.g., Asia-Pacific and Europe), and strong stakeholder coordination skills to drive cross-functional teams toward on-time project delivery. Key Responsibilities
New Warehouse Construction Management

Timeline & Results Management
- Develop detailed project plans (WBS, critical path, resource calendars) and track progress rigorously.

Communication & Reporting

Minimum Qualification(s):

- Proficiency with project management tools (MS Project, Smartsheet, Jira, etc.).

Preferred Qualification(s):

- Prior experience building and leading a project team (recruiting, training, performance management).
